notes_for_validator.subject: c12 needs restating: its baseline cannot exist under this ramp
notes_for_validator.claim: c12 -- p0loss at >= 200 k samples below p0loss at <= 20 k samples
notes_for_validator.problem: check_metrics.py reports c12 UNAVAILABLE: 'need an export at <= 20000 samples (0 found) and one at >= 200000 samples (5 found)'. Under the admitted export ramp the FIRST export lands at 143744 samples (t9-s143744-d157367), so no export at <= 20000 samples can ever exist on this run and the comparison as specified is unsatisfiable. This is a property of the ramp, not a failure of the chain, and re-running would not produce a <= 20 k export either.
notes_for_validator.substance_is_evidenced: the loss falls monotonically across every export of link 1: p0loss 3.603458 -> 2.731470, vloss 0.871793 -> 0.568837, pacc1 0.075852 -> 0.362401, over samples 143744 -> 1762560 (a 12x increase). Full table in evidence/production_chain/status_log.txt read 2.
notes_for_validator.proposed_restatement: compare against the FIRST AVAILABLE export rather than a <= 20 k baseline, e.g. 'p0loss at the latest export is below p0loss at the first export by a margin exceeding the run-to-run spread', which the link-1 data satisfies with 2.731 < 3.603.
notes_for_validator.decision_owner: validator -- the worker does not restate an admitted claim

notes_for_validator.subject: R16 (b) threshold is calibrated on one link and wants review
notes_for_validator.detail: the authorised restatement of R16 shipped with NODATA_NO_EXPORT_RUN=6 in chain_status.sh. The proposed value was 3, but the healthy link-1 ramp reaches a run of 4 (exports at cycles 5,10,15,17,20,22 leave gaps of 4 at cycles 6-9 and 11-14) and the validator's own predicted ramp 5,10,15,19,22 has the same maximum gap, so 3 fires on a good chain. 6 is one clear step above the observed and predicted maximum. Calibrated on ONE link; it is a monitoring parameter of the reader, not a knob of the run.

notes_for_validator.subject: T1 violated in production; NUM_GAMES_PER_CYCLE is the knob, decision belongs to scale_data_window
notes_for_validator.finding: rows/game real = 22.174 aggregate over 36040 real-net games and 18.525 marginal over the last 8000, against the T1 requirement rows_per_cycle >= 1.2*E = 24000. Aggregate margin -7.61 %, marginal -22.81 %; at the marginal rate a cycle yields 1475 FEWER new rows than one epoch draws.
notes_for_validator.mechanism_measured: the derivation's r = 32.300 was a 20-game probe on a barely-trained net. In production moves/game fell 130.8 -> ~81 between the first and third accepted net and has been flat at 80-82 since (a one-time learning transition), while rows-per-move drifts 0.252 -> 0.227 against the ~0.25 that cheapSearchProb 0.75 implies. Resignation is refuted as a cause: RE[...+R] is 0.0 % in every net directory.
notes_for_validator.not_yet_harmful: the bucket is not starving ('not enough new data rows, terminating' still 1, longest run 1 vs the R14 threshold 3); MAX_TRAIN_PER_DATA 8 leaves reuse headroom and the loop keeps exporting and accepting 13/13.
notes_for_validator.options: G >= 1296 restores T1 (>= 1.2*E); G >= 1080 restores rows_per_cycle >= E; or accept a lower freshness ratio explicitly and record it as a narrowing of T1. NOT applied -- a knob move is out of this packet's scope (section 13) and the P8 row says the knob check's FAIL is recorded for scale_data_window, never tuned here.

notes_for_validator.subject: check_knobs_9x9.py cannot evaluate production throughput -- it expects the smoke's phase layout
notes_for_validator.detail: the P8-prescribed re-run `check_knobs_9x9.py --throughput <production throughput.json> --rows-file <rows_per_game.txt>` exits 1 with "missing the measured key(s) per_phase_stage['cycle2/gatekeeper'].elapsed_s". Under the admitted export ramp cycle 2 has NO gatekeeper stage (the first gate is at cycle 6), while the checker expects the smoke layout in which cycle 2 did gate. The exit 1 is 'cannot evaluate', not 'T1 refuted'; o41 is behaving as designed by refusing to substitute a constant. Until the checker tolerates a ramp whose gate starts at cycle 6, the P8 knob re-run cannot be satisfied on production data and the T1 arithmetic has to be done directly from the measured r, as it was at this read.
